rubric.why: Increasing atomic size or shielding weakens the nucleus's attraction for shared electrons down a group.
rubric.description: Correct reason for the decrease down a group.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that increased atomic size or shielding weakens the attraction for shared electrons.

modelAnswer: Electronegativity is the ability of an atom to attract the shared pair of electrons towards itself in a covalent bond.
Down a group, atomic size and shielding increase, so the nucleus attracts the shared electrons less strongly; therefore, electronegativity generally decreases.
